notes:
Context: mid-market product analytics company building an in-app assistant + search layer. Ran 2-week hosted API trial; now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

Trial findings (hosted API):
- Average QPS during peak user sessions: 6-10 QPS; spiky bursts to ~25 QPS for short windows.
- Observed concurrency (active streaming/generation requests): ~18-30 concurrent requests during peak business hours.
- Token mix: ~65% short interactions (prompt + 40-80 tokens), ~25% medium (200-600 tokens), ~10% long context/summary jobs up to ~2k tokens. Avg generation tokens per request ~120.
- Embeddings: account for ~28% of total API calls (batch embeddings for doc vectors, executed off-peak where possible).
- Latency SLO desired: p95 <= 300ms for short chat responses; p99 target 600ms. Currently hitting p95 ~350ms on hosted at peak.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if unit token price reduction >= 30% vs hosted list.

Dedicated sizing asks (what Novapulse wants from Redwood):
- Concrete GPU-sizing recommendation based on observed QPS/concurrency + token mix above. SE suggested two sizing options: (1) baseline: 2x A10G / equivalent for steady-state ~10 QPS and cache enabled; (2) performance: 1x H100 / or 4x A10G split for headroom to handle bursts to 30 QPS with KV caching. Customer wants comparative latency/cost estimates for both.
- Autoscale burst policy prefer burst to hosted API rather than queueing. Need explicit fallback routing plan.
- Request: run a simulated load test with customer's synthetic traffic trace (they will share week-of-03-22).

Security/compliance notes:
- Primary blockers: SOC2 scope alignment, KMS integration for key separation, audit log retention policy (90 days min for EU users), SSO (SAML) integration timeline.
- Data residency: want clarification on EU region hosting for EEA customers; will need signed data-residency term in contract.

POC & Commercial timeline:
- POC scope: 2-week dedicated trial with traffic replay and load test; include detailed token accounting + cost deltas.
- Pricing ask: committed monthly baseline + overage model. Need spreadsheet with monthly committed QPS, estimated token volume, expected ARR impact. (See linked Drive pricing deck).
- Stakeholders: VP Product (Sarah D.), Head of Infra (Rohit M.), Finance lead (Emily C.). Finance is gate for procurement; finance wants a 12-month committed pricing scenario.

- "Main risk is unpredictable cost if bursts spike; need explicit burst caps and cost-smoothing." — Rohit M.
